basic_profile.bio: I'm a 15-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, still navigating high school life. I love exploring new games like ZombsRoyale and have a keen interest in unsolved mysteries, particularly the case of Jennifer Kesse. I spend a lot of time learning about digital tools and software, with Houdini being my current obsession. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school and on weekends. My parents are supportive but keep a close watch on my screen time. Currently, I'm single and focused on balancing schoolwork with my tech hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm primarily self-taught, diving into forums, YouTube tutorials, and online courses to expand my understanding of technology and digital media. My school offers a basic computer science class, but I often find myself going beyond the curriculum to satisfy my curiosity.
